author: Kützing, 1841

note.en: A soft tuft of fine red threads, close to Spyridia filamentosa and hard to tell from it by eye, recorded at Punta Cahuita and in Cahuita National Park.
note.es: Un mechón suave de hilos rojos finos, muy parecido a Spyridia filamentosa y difícil de distinguir a simple vista, registrado en Punta Cahuita y en el Parque Nacional Cahuita.

evidence: GBIF herbarium specimens: Cahuita National Park (2019, 0.5 m), Punta Cahuita (1972 and 1999)

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)
